# Class `puc::ipc::MetaChannel`

One logical channel composed from multiple delivery mechanisms.

`transmit()` sends the same complete message to every underlying channel in vector order. Success requires every destination to accept it; a mixture of successes and failures returns [Status::PARTIAL\_TRANSFER](namespacepuc_1_1ipc.md#symbol-namespacepuc_1_1ipc_1a2d9525a8274577936e23d73e7264f5e4a17edd2cb41ee011eba06b3589bc9024e). Messages received by any underlying channel are delivered once to the [MetaChannel](#)'s current subscribers. Thus an echoing underlying channel, such as [SmemChannel](classpuc_1_1ipc_1_1_smem_channel.md), naturally contributes one inbound delivery during fan-out.

Underlying channels are retained for this object's lifetime. Destruction disables the private forwarding subscriptions before releasing those references. As with every [Channel](classpuc_1_1ipc_1_1_channel.md), callers must not destroy the object from inside one of its own callbacks.

### `MetaChannel`

```cpp
puc::ipc::MetaChannel::MetaChannel(std::string name, std::vector< std::shared_ptr< Channel > > underlying_channels, ChannelOptions options={})
```

Construct a logical channel over distinct, non-null channels.

At least one healthy underlying channel is required. Inspect `status()` before use; construction reports the first invalid underlying status or [Status::INVALID\_ARGUMENT](namespacepuc_1_1ipc.md#symbol-namespacepuc_1_1ipc_1a2d9525a8274577936e23d73e7264f5e4af295a0c3e37c94f078e1c5476479132d) for an empty/null/duplicate collection.
